import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_sub.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission columns: {sample_sub.columns.tolist()}")


# Text preprocessing function
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text).strip()
    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
        text = text[1:-1]
    try:
        text = text.encode("utf-8").decode("unicode_escape")
    except:
        pass
    return text


# Feature engineering
def extract_features(texts):
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if pd.isna(text):
            text = ""
        else:
            text = str(text)
        length = len(text)
        word_count = len(text.split())
        alpha_chars = [c for c in text if c.isalpha()]
        cap_ratio = sum(1 for c in alpha_chars if c.isupper()) / max(
            len(alpha_chars), 1
        )
        exclamation_count = text.count("!")
        question_count = text.count("?")
        words = text.split()
        all_caps_words = sum(1 for w in words if w.isupper() and len(w) > 1)
        features.append(
            [
                length,
                word_count,
                cap_ratio,
                exclamation_count,
                question_count,
                all_caps_words,
            ]
        )
    return np.array(features)


# Clean text
train_df["cleaned_comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["cleaned_comment"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Extract engineered features
train_features = extract_features(train_df["cleaned_comment"])
test_features = extract_features(test_df["cleaned_comment"])

# TF-IDF vectorization
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2, max_df=0.95, sublinear_tf=True
)
word_features = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["cleaned_comment"])
test_word_features = word_vectorizer.transform(test_df["cleaned_comment"])

char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000,
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)
char_features = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["cleaned_comment"])
test_char_features = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["cleaned_comment"])

# Combine all features
train_combined = hstack([word_features, char_features, csr_matrix(train_features)])
test_combined = hstack(
    [test_word_features, test_char_features, csr_matrix(test_features)]
)

print(f"Combined feature shape: {train_combined.shape}")

# Use k-fold cross-validation for reliable validation score
n_splits = 5
kf = KFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
y_train = train_df["Insult"].values

# Cross-validation to get reliable validation score on hold-out data
cv_predictions = np.zeros(len(y_train))
cv_scores = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(kf.split(train_combined)):
    X_train_fold = train_combined[train_idx]
    y_train_fold = y_train[train_idx]
    X_val_fold = train_combined[val_idx]
    y_val_fold = y_train[val_idx]

    model = Ridge(alpha=1.0, random_state=42)
    model.fit(X_train_fold, y_train_fold)

    val_pred = model.predict(X_val_fold)
    val_pred = np.clip(val_pred, 0, 1)
    cv_predictions[val_idx] = val_pred

    fold_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_fold, val_pred)
    cv_scores.append(fold_auc)
    print(f"Fold {fold+1} AUC-ROC: {fold_auc:.6f}")

# Calculate mean CV AUC on hold-out validation data
mean_cv_auc = np.mean(cv_scores)
std_cv_auc = np.std(cv_scores)
print(f"\nMean CV AUC-ROC: {mean_cv_auc:.6f} (+/- {std_cv_auc:.6f})")

# Train final model on ALL training data for test predictions
final_model = Ridge(alpha=1.0, random_state=42)
final_model.fit(train_combined, y_train)

# Generate final predictions on test set
test_pred = final_model.predict(test_combined)
test_pred = np.clip(test_pred, 0, 1)

# Create submission file with correct format matching sample_submission
submission = pd.DataFrame()
for col in sample_sub.columns:
    if col in ["Insult", "insult", "Insult"]:
        submission[col] = test_pred
    else:
        # For ID column, use the index from test set or match sample submission
        submission[col] = sample_sub[col].values

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission columns: {submission.columns.tolist()}")
print(f"Total test samples: {len(test_pred)}")
print(f"Prediction range: [{test_pred.min():.6f}, {test_pred.max():.6f}]")
print(f"Mean prediction: {test_pred.mean():.6f}")
